kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
امتعضوا (form VIII)
# اِمْتَعَضُوا (imtaʕaḍū) /im.ta.ʕa.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# اُمْتُعِضُوا (umtuʕiḍū) /um.tu.ʕi.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# اِمْتَعِضُوا (imtaʕiḍū) /im.ta.ʕi.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
